g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B1 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 22.5 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: NO. NDE: 10 % RT of BW.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. TV-1045 station on platform at E-113 (EL 103.0) - access by stair from grade.
7. Riser at C-101 offset 0.95 m east of nozzle to clear BPA draw and P-112 discharge crossings.
